utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Hi, how are you doing today?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I am good, thanks, how about you?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Great. Are you familiar with CoderPad?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Yes, I have used it before.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Can you access the CoderPad link and open it?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Can you run some simple lines of code in CoderPad to make sure it works?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Okay. So tell me about yourself.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I am a backend engineer with five years of experience building payment systems in Go.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Now please write a function to reverse a linked list and explain the complexity.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I will iterate with three pointers, previous, current and next. It is O of n time and O of one space. I think that is it.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Tell me about a time you missed a deadline.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Um, I do not think I ever missed one really.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Do you have any questions for me?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: What does the team work on day to day?

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Great, our recruiter will follow up with next steps. Have a nice day.
